{{Quote|Ah, gentlebeings. Hello, my name is Gustip. I am understanding you are in possession of a ship and a desire for credits, this is correct?|Gustip, to a group of spacers|<ref name="SoF" />}}
'''Gustip''' was a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] to the billionaire businessman and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Benton Kaldo]]. Gustip oversaw the day-to-day operation and bookkeeping of Kaldo's criminal enterprises on [[Centerpoint Station]], both in the upscale [[Hollowtown]] and the seedier [[Null Town]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am in need of a ship and crew to dance the 'Corellian Shuffle.'|Gustip, to a group of spacers|<ref name="SoF" />}}
Gustip was very meticulous and always carried himself with the bearing of an aristocrat. He regularly wore a white suit of a style that matched his employer and was never without his [[aurodium]]-plated cane. Whenever he traveled outside of Baron Kaldo's estates, he surrounded himself with a gang of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gus first appears in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a source book for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire|''Edge of the Empire'']] roleplaying game that was released in [[2014]].
